thread:
incident-bot: Pager P1 — AUTHZ-REDIS-LEAK triggered for redis-proxy-prod. Suspicious outbound log writes containing auth-like tokens to s3://inference-raw-logs-prod. Alert ID: AUTHZ-REDIS-LEAK. First observed 2026-03-18T02:43:21Z.
emma_oncall: oncall ack — I'm on it, paging sec + infra. starting triage.
amy_sec: on it. any customer impact seen so far?
dave_infra: pulling infra logs now. early signal: log-forwarder pod restarted ~02:42 with new config. seeing DEBUG lines that include auth_token fields being forwarded.
emma_oncall: can you paste a sanitized snippet? which process wrote the tokens?
dave_infra: ```Mar 18 02:43:21 redis-proxy-03 forwarder[3124]: DEBUG payload: auth_token=sk-xxxx... user_id=acct_987 path=/v1/infer client=svc-ingest```
amy_sec: that looks like ephemeral session tokens in forwarder logs. @lee_csm please check which tenants had traffic to redis-proxy-03 around that time.
lee_csm: checking tenant request logs. early match: AcornHealth (tenant-id: acorn-11) and LexaForms (tenant-id: lexa-2) show elevated calls 02:41–02:44 UTC.
emma_oncall: crucial q: are those tokens still valid? proposal: immediate rotation/revoke and stop log shipping. amy/dave ok? ETA 20m?
amy_sec: agreed. suggested steps: 1) disable log forwarder to s3 (infra) 2) rotate service account/access keys for forwarder (infra) 3) revoke ephemeral/session tokens issued in that window via auth service (sec) 4) preserve forensic snapshot and pause customer notification until legal gives ok (legal/csm).
dave_infra: executing step 1: `kubectl -n infra delete deploy/log-forwarder-prod --grace-period=0` — will confirm when offline.
incident-bot: Runbook note: auth-leak-rotate started by emma_oncall. Notifying SRE channel.
dave_infra: forwarder deletion done. confirming s3 writes dropped to zero; tail on forwarder logs shows stop.
amy_sec: starting token revocation: `python tools/revoke_tokens.py --since 2026-03-18T02:40Z --until 2026-03-18T02:46Z --source=redis-proxy-03` — posting summary when complete.
amy_sec: revoke output: "revoked_ephemeral_tokens=4321; long_lived_keys_affected=0; revocation_duration=38s"
lee_csm: compiling impacted customer counts. AcornHealth: 152 tokens, LexaForms: 89 tokens, others: 7. Preparing outreach draft.
dave_infra: rotated IAM creds used by forwarder: created new key (NEWKEY-XXXX), disabled OLDKEY1234. CloudTrail shows GetObject hits to the bucket during the window from two external IPs (aggregator-range). I'm applying WAF deny rules now.
incident-bot: WAF update applied: 2 IPs added to block list. Observation logged in incident timeline.
priya_legal: I'm on call. preserve forensic artifacts and do not send customer-facing communications until I review initial summary (need timeline + exposure scope + mitigation actions).
emma_oncall: acknowledged. forensic snapshot command: `aws s3 cp s3://inference-raw-logs-prod/2026-03-18/ ./forensics/ --recursive --exclude "*" --include "02*"` — completed, checksums recorded.
dave_infra: forensic snapshot saved to forensics S3 (readonly). spun up read-only analysis instance. initial look: no large-scale exfil beyond the two GetObject events; copying logs for deep analysis.
amy_sec: running token use audit to find any token reuse/external requests after revocation. starting query against auth-audit DB now.
amy_sec: token-audit results (prelim): "unauthorized_usage_hits=0; unusual_token_replay=2 (investigating)"
lee_csm: draft customer message ready (holding per legal): "We detected an internal log forwarding misconfiguration that included ephemeral session tokens in logs. We have revoked affected tokens, disabled the forwarder, rotated service credentials, applied blocking rules, and are investigating. We will update within 2 hours with a timeline and remediation steps. Contact support@redwood if you need immediate help."
priya_legal: legal provisional approval for holding message. require final verification on PII exposure and a short timeline before sending. prepare timeline doc for review.
emma_oncall: tagging incident for postmortem: labels -> data_exposure=yes, customer_impact=partial, severity=P1. action owners: forensics=dave_infra, auth_audit=amy_sec, customer_comm=lee_csm, legal=priya_legal.
dave_infra: forensics notes: snapshot preserved, initial indicators of compromise limited to GetObject from two external IPs during 02:42–02:44 UTC. blocked and IAM keys rotated. next: finish object-level access review and rotate any remaining service tokens.
amy_sec: auth audit completed: revoked tokens invalidated; active session count down ~0.8% cluster-wide. running a follow-up check for replay attempts.
lee_csm: sending private-notify to affected customers once legal signs off. prepping support runbook for escalations.
priya_legal: confirmed hold for public statement until we have timeline + scope; internal customer outreach OK with legal.
emma_oncall: closing initial bridge for live mitigation. keep thread open for updates, please drop major updates here only. thanks all for fast response. :thumbsup:
